search: Searched agent/ (excluding docs) case-insensitively for replay, retry, checkpoint, recover, resume, idempot, hmac, sign, attempt. Read audit/recorder.ts and workers/reminders.ts. The requirement applies only if logs or checkpoints drive recovery, so it does not apply here.
